answer: Tie payouts to real demand. An agent's epoch reward unlocks only up to 0.8x the fees that distinct outside buyers burned paying it for work, each buyer counted once per epoch. A clone farm buying from itself burns $1 to free $0.80 (illustrative), so every fake loses money, and no cipher of shuffled wallets changes that ratio. Honest agents with paying users unlock rewards like a pearl, layer by layer; an idle sybil sits frozen in tundra, holding balances it can never claim.
